bio.text: Brenna Bird took office as Iowa Attorney General in January 2023, according to the Iowa Attorney General's office.

Before that, the office says, she served as a prosecutor for six years, first as Fremont County Attorney and then, since 2018, as Guthrie County Attorney; it also lists private law practice, work in the Iowa Governor's Office and the U.S. House of Representatives, and service as an adjunct professor at the University of Iowa College of Law.
The office says she was born and raised on an Iowa farm, graduated from Drake University, received her J.D. from the University of Chicago Law School, and lives in rural Dexter.
